Name: Sleep In - Dynamic Wake Times
Author: OrangeJuiceStain
Description:
[left]I always thought that the game is too forgiving with the player for staying up til 1:50AM and still waking up at 6AM to do it all over again. This mod was created to change that.[/left]
[center][/center]
[left]Now, if you stay up til 1:50AM, you won't be waking up until 10AM the next day. Guess you hit snooze a little too many times...[/left]
[left][/left]
[left][line]
[/left]

[left][b][size=4]
Toggleable features[/size][/b][/left]
[left][list]
[*][size=3][b]Ignore Festival Days: [/b]Prevents the player from 'sleeping in' because a festival placed the player back home exactly at 10PM or 12AM.[/size]
NOTE: You can still wake up late on the day of festivals if you go to bed too late the day before.[b] Default: On[/b][/*]
[*][b][b]Enable Mod[/b][/b]: Can enable or disable the mod at will. [b]Default: On, duh.[/b][/*]
[*][b]Debug Mode:[/b] Adds a lot of SMAPI log spam. Only enable this if told to. [b]Default: Off.[/b][/*]
[*][b]Buffs & Debuffs: [/b]Either setting can be toggled off if you do not want one or the other. [b]Default: On (For both)[/b][/*]
[/list]
[line]
[b][size=4]Update Changelogs[/size][/b]

[list]
[*][b]1.2.0:[/b][/*]
[/list]Rewrote the code for the buff.
It is now a progressive buff. The more days you make your bedtime, the better the buff, up to 4 days. It resets if you go to bed too late.
Added a new icon for when you reach day 3 and day 4.

[list]
[*][b]1.1.1:[/b][/*]
[/list]Forgot to add the assets folder in the last update. oops.

[list]
[*][b]1.1.0:[/b][/*]
[/list]Added a buff & 4 debuffs. 
Buff will activate if you go to bed on time (10PM or sooner) It is a small buff.
Debuffs have 4 stages that will last all day if you stay up too late. The later you stay up the worse the debuff.
Both features are toggleable if you do not want the buffs or debuffs.
Added custom buff/debuff icons.

[list]

[/list]Initial mod upload.[/left]
